composites.name: predator_prey_abm
composites.description: Agent-based model: a well-mixed stochastic Lotka-Volterra predator-prey model as a population of DISCRETE individuals with stochastic birth/predation/death events, advanced by the exact Gillespie SSA in a native process-bigraph process. Integer-count state, one stochastic trajectory per run. This is the model that is NOT an SBML/ODE model — the adversarial case for the 'any model is an SBML model' claim.

composites.name: predator_prey_meanfield
composites.description: Mean-field reduction: the deterministic Lotka-Volterra ODE as Antimony integrated by libroadrunner/CVODE in a TelluriumProcess — the SBML reduction of the stochastic ABM. Faithful only in the large-population, well-mixed, deterministic limit; it structurally cannot represent the ABM's stochasticity, discreteness, or extinction.

composites.name: engine_monolithic
composites.description: Generic monolith: a whole SBML/Antimony model (registry id or raw Antimony) in ONE process node of the chosen engine — tellurium (libroadrunner/CVODE, bulk species), copasi (COPASI/basico LSODA, overwrite coupling) or native (glycolysis-only hand-ported RHS). config.model carries the Antimony for every engine.
methods: one engine process over the whole model (tellurium | copasi | native)

composites.name: native_composite
composites.description: The fully-native pbg reference: the glycolysis ODE network as a hand-ported NativeGlycolysisProcess (scalar map[float] leaf, scipy LSODA, no simulator at runtime). The engine='native' monolith; glycolysis-specific.

composites.name: ensemble
composites.description: Generic ensemble: N independent whole-model instances of any registry model/engine. intervals=None is the same-rate ensemble (Ray-parallel runner, optional per-instance parameter draws); intervals='geometric' (or a list) is the multi-rate case, one node per instance on its own interval, driven by process-bigraph #270's event-heap scheduler. config.model carries the Antimony.
methods: multi-rate: geometric per-instance intervals, #270 heap scheduler

composites.name: reaction_split
composites.description: Generic reaction split: a model's reactions partitioned by `seam` (aldolase | mechanical | explicit upper/lower lists) into two process nodes, each in its own engine (tellurium | copasi | native), coupled only through ONE shared additive species store (per-interval deltas sum). config.model carries the Antimony.
methods: two engine nodes over one additive species store (Jacobi split)

composites.name: recover_mass_action
composites.description: Candidate-model run for the recover-mass-action study: a flat SBML/Antimony candidate integrated monolithically in tellurium (libroadrunner), emitting A/B/C trajectories to compare against the hidden mass-action oracle. Default candidate = the ground-truth model (identity baseline). Target generation, trajectory comparison and structural scoring are applied by the recovery capabilities around this run.
methods: one tellurium process over the candidate flat-SBML model

composites.name: recover_candidate
composites.description: Generic candidate-model run for any recovery-ladder study: integrates the candidate flat-SBML monolithically in tellurium and emits its species trajectories. `target` selects the ground-truth oracle (recover-mass-action | recover-enzyme-kinetics | recover-gene-switch | recover-oscillator); `candidate_model` (optional raw Antimony) overrides it with a proposed model. Default (empty candidate_model) = the oracle itself, the identity baseline. Target generation, comparison and structural scoring are applied around the run by the recovery capabilities.
methods: one tellurium process over the candidate flat-SBML model
